characters.name: Aase Gaasepige
characters.description: Aase Gaasepige is depicted as a striking bride in a royal wedding scene. She is adorned in lavish, ornate bridal attire, featuring intricate embroidery and delicate fabrics that highlight her regal presence. Aase possesses a graceful and poised demeanor, embodying the elegance of a bride marrying into royalty. Her hair is styled elegantly, showcasing her noble transformation. The setting is lively and vibrant, with rich decorations symbolizing a joyous and celebratory atmosphere, filling the scene with an air of festivity and grandeur.

characters.name: Gutten
characters.description: Gutten is a whimsical and clever young boy, characterized by his playful intelligence and curiosity. He is depicted holding a nut containing the devil, standing confidently on a country road. Gutten's expression is one of cunning and mischief, with a hint of triumph as he has successfully tricked the devil. He has a youthful appearance, with tousled hair and simple clothing indicating his humble origins.

characters.name: Fanden
characters.description: Fanden, or the devil, is portrayed as having been tricked into a small form inside a nut. Although not visible in the scene, Fanden's presence is implied by the context and the mischievous success of the boy. He represents a figure of power and mischief, subdued by the cleverness of a mere boy.

characters.name: Smeden
characters.description: Smeden is a robust and strong blacksmith with an intense, determined demeanor. He is depicted in his shop, filled with various blacksmith tools and implements. Smeden's build is sturdy, befitting his profession, and he is engaged in the energetic task of using a large hammer to break open a nut on the anvil. His expression is focused and slightly frustrated, showing his determination to succeed in his task.

characters.name: Par Fattige Folk
characters.description: The par fattige folk are an elderly couple living in a modest, humble hut in the woods. They exude warmth and humility, evident in their simple lifestyle and weathered appearance. Both appear worn by the hardships of life, wearing plain, faded clothing that echoes their poor circumstances. Despite their poverty, there is a sense of resilience and contentment in their small abode, surrounded by nature.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden, the youngest son, is a young boy with an air of laziness and daydreaming. He is typically found lying by the fireplace, covered in ash, reflecting his nickname as the 'Ash Lad.' He has a disheveled look, wearing simple clothes suitable for lounging, with dark hair and a relaxed, untroubled expression as he idly stirs the ash.

characters.name: Eldste Gutten
characters.description: Eldste Gutten, the eldest son of the poor couple, is depicted as a hopeful and determined young man embarking on a journey to find work. He is portrayed as a traveler moving confidently towards a majestic castle, symbolizing his aspirations. He has a sturdy build and an earnest expression, wearing practical attire suitable for travel. His demeanor is one of determination and ambition, eager to make his way in the world.
